name: @nexus/frontend
description: Nexus ERP Colombia web app (shell, design system, modules). Dependencies are pinned in the root package.json.

scripts.test: node src/app/tools/ensure-deps.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=junit --outputFile.junit=../reports/junit/frontend.xml
scripts.e2e: node src/app/tools/ensure-deps.mjs && PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 playwright test --config src/app/e2e/playwright.config.ts
